meta.name: c4-diagrams
meta.description: Creates C4 architecture diagrams for designing, documenting, or understanding software architecture. Use when working through system design, mapping existing codebases, or visualizing structure at any level from system landscape down to code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 C4 模型绘制清晰的系统架构图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计、记录或梳理软件系统的架构层次
copy.tagline_en: Create clear system architecture diagrams with the C4 model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design, document, or clarify software system architecture

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的描述或代码库，创建 C4 架构图（系统上下文、容器、组件、代码等层级），帮助你设计、记录或理解软件架构。
howto.when: 当你讨论系统设计、分析现有代码、或想可视化软件结构（从系统全景到代码级）时，Claude 会主动创建C4图。

say.text: 帮我画这个支付系统的容器图。
say.note: Claude会分析系统，生成容器层级的C4图。

say.text: 为我的代码库生成系统上下文图。
say.note: Claude会探索代码，识别用户和外部系统。

say.text: 解释这个微服务的组件结构。
say.note: Claude会绘制组件图，展示内部模块。

howto.what_en: Claude creates C4 architecture diagrams (system context, containers, components, code) based on your descriptions or codebase, helping you design, document, or understand software architecture.
howto.when_en: When you are discussing system design, analyzing existing code, or wanting to visualize software structure from system landscape down to code level, Claude proactively creates C4 diagrams.

say_en.text: Create a container diagram for this payment system.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the system and generates a container-level C4 diagram.

say_en.text: Generate a system context diagram for my codebase.
say_en.note: Claude explores the code to identify users and external systems.

say_en.text: Explain the component structure of this microservice.
say_en.note: Claude draws a component diagram showing internal modules.
